objective: Determine whether FlashAttention origin/subtiling supplies a bounded SM103a FP16 D32 dense-noncausal M64 candidate that can cross B300's two-resident-CTA resource boundary without a blind tile or accumulator sweep.

source_identity.retained_main_role: source of the accepted M128N128/q2/kv24 native SM103a kernel

source_anchors.fact: tile_m=64 sets p_in_smem and rejects arch != 100 before compilation; FP16/BF16 and the head-dimension envelope are checked here
M64 forces q_stage=1, rejects 2CTA/CLC/non-TMA configurations, and independently permits only Arch.sm_100a or Arch.sm_100f
SM103 uses native exp2 and disables tcgen05.ld.red for unmodified D32 scores, but this logic is reached only after the M64 SM100-only constructor guard
the kernel fixes sixteen warps/512 threads and assigns D32 register budgets softmax=200, correction=64, other=48
KV stages are selected to fill a 224 KiB budget after Q/O and SMEM-P, capped at 32 rather than by the exact S361 N-block count
M64 changes the PV tcgen05 A operand from TMEM to SMEM; this is an algorithmic SMEM-P path, not a smaller instance of the retained TMEM-P kernel
the aligned SharedStorage definition provides the exact barrier, Q, O, KV, scale, and P byte accounting used below
warp-specialized setmaxnreg instructions apply the 200/64/48 register budgets
every path allocates get_max_tmem_alloc_cols("sm_100"), i.e. all 512 TMEM columns, even when M64 needs fewer logical columns
StaticPersistentTileScheduler caps a one-CTA cluster grid at the physical SM count, so B300 launches 148 rather than 296 CTAs
M64 dense tests cover FP16 D96 and several BF16 dimensions, but not FP16 D32/D32 or S361; a dedicated test requires arch 103 to fail with only-on-SM100
TMEM capacity is 512 columns for SM100 and SM103; allocations are power-of-two values from 32 through 512

feature_envelope.fp16: accepted by the declared M64 dtype guard
feature_envelope.head_dim_32: accepted by supports_sm100_tile_m64_head_dims because both QK and V are in [8,128] and divisible by 8
feature_envelope.dense_noncausal: supported by the algorithm shape and static-persistent scheduler
test_gaps: the test suite explicitly asserts that arch 103 is rejected

tmem_formula.conclusion: M64N128 cannot have two simultaneous TMEM allocations; M64N64 would require changing the allocator request from 512 to 256 before two TMEM users are even possible

register_formula.conclusion: two CTAs cannot co-reside under the shipped warp/register topology even if shared memory is reduced

grid_formula.conclusion: M64 increases logical work tiles but does not increase the persistent launch window; a separate two-CTA-per-SM scheduler and grid-stride contract is required

coupled_blockers.name: SM103 SMEM-P architecture port
coupled_blockers.requirement: prove the 16-datapath SMEM-P tcgen05 PV instruction, barrier mapping, correction scaling, and universal epilogue copy on SM103 before removing both independent SM100 guards

coupled_blockers.name: exact-shape KV stage policy
coupled_blockers.requirement: reduce M64N64 from the default 32 KV stages to at most 22 without starving the S361 pipeline

coupled_blockers.name: partial TMEM allocation
coupled_blockers.requirement: allocate 256 rather than 512 TMEM columns for M64N64 and validate all score/output offsets and lifetime barriers

coupled_blockers.name: two-resident persistent scheduler
coupled_blockers.requirement: launch approximately 296 CTAs, stride persistent work by that grid, and request/verify min_blocks_per_mp=2 instead of the shipped 148/1 contract

coupled_blockers.name: warp and register topology redesign
coupled_blockers.requirement: reduce the 46080-register CTA footprint below 32768 registers, likely by removing unused q_stage-2 warps and retuning softmax registers rather than merely applying a compiler cap

decision.reason: the only theoretically resource-eligible shape, M64N64, requires all five coupled structural changes; unguarding M64, changing tile_n, or changing KV stages alone remains one-resident due to TMEM, grid, and registers
reopen_conditions: upstream publishes and tests an SM103 M64 SMEM-P forward path
or a dedicated SM103 design simultaneously demonstrates M64N64/kv<=22, TMEM256, grid296, and <=32768 registers per CTA in compile-time resource evidence
the candidate must preserve FP32 QK/PV accumulation, native SM103 exp2, and D32 ld.red disabled before isolated correctness or GPU timing
